scientific_integrity: The eigenvalue formula and classical variation lemma are identified as antecedents; only the stated sharp spectral modal ceiling, finite norm certificate and all-m sharpness are put forward for review.
scientific_limitations: Finite disjoint concentric annuli, one complex dimension and a Gaussian window; exact candidate roots may require rigorous numerical isolation. A prior equivalent use of total positivity for this spectral family cannot be excluded. The Descartes lemma and the diagonal eigenvalue formula are classical. Independent priority verification has not been performed.
title: A sharp modal ceiling and finite spectral-norm certificate for multi-annular Gaussian localization
